pregame.pressurePoint: Wake Forest run game vs NC State run defense. Wake Forest is No. 29 of 138 in rush success rate (49%). NC State ranks No. 105 against the run (45%). This is not a lean. It is a mismatch, and a prominent one. Expect Wake Forest to lean on the run early and often, and to keep leaning. Once NC State loads the box, play-action is the second punch. Watch Wake Forest's rushing attempts by halftime. North of 20 means the plan is working.

edges.why: Wake Forest is No. 4 of 138 at limiting explosive passes (1.14). NC State ranks No. 111 in pass explosiveness (1.41). This is not a lean. It is a mismatch, and a prominent one. Deep balls are the lowest-percentage play in this game. NC State needs the underneath game and yards after catch.
